item.title: VOL. 16 NO.1, SPECIAL EDITION 2022
item.description: VOL. 16 NO.1, SPECIAL EDITION 2022 The Romanian Journal of Society and Politics’ special issue of 2022 is centred on the Eastern and South-Eastern European (ESEE) Fanel Network’s international academic conference - “The Other Europe? Resilience and Assertiveness in our region” and we chose an article representative for each FANEL.
